_comment: Tightened per the 2026-08-13 policy decision: every column is ENFORCED except the four allowed discrepancies in not_comparable. known_gaps is deliberately empty — a disagreement fails the test instead of parking.
_capture_comment: Per-page envelopes for the eight pages carrying the covered SKUs, captured in-session from Vetapet.pdf (verbatim tables, letterhead as supplier_identity_text, page brand marks as page_brand_text). The whole-document envelope this replaced predated both page-level fields.
_parked_comment: TOP250 (Topizole) stays out of expected.csv: the catalogue prints it as two same-code quantity-band rows (1-10 bottles at $82, 11-20 at $78) and no folding mechanism exists — see VETAPET_VET_QUANTITY_BAND_ROWS on the contract. Its page (39) is deliberately not captured.
_missing_comment: APQ-L, VANG5L and VANG-RCP stay in expected.csv but cannot publish: their tables price under headings the contract cannot claim (Apoquel's per-order-qty ladder columns; the vaccine layouts). Their pages (12, 7, 8) are not captured; they join covered_skus when the contract learns those layouts.
_conformed_comment: Cells conformed to the chosen conventions (user authorization 2026-08-13, 'I'll ensure it's conformed to even if I have to change the golden samples'): brand = the verbatim page brand mark; basis/packaging text = the export's canonical rendering; a sheet cell asserting data the page does not print is blanked. Every conformed cell is listed in docs/../vetapet sheet-edit ledger accompanying the commit; substantive corrections (ROT prints 90 capsules, not 100 tablets) are called out there too.

not_comparable.product_name: allowed discrepancy (policy 2026-08-13): the sheet holds a human shorthand; the export holds the supplier's printed description
not_comparable.product name [Rosetta]: allowed discrepancy: a hand-authored retail name, not something the pipeline derives
not_comparable.weight: allowed discrepancy: some catalogues genuinely do not print it, and the sheet hand-measures
not_comparable.sellable_uom: allowed discrepancy: not always capturable from the source — BizOps set the sellable unit themselves
